svg.title: APPLOCKER ON DOMAIN CONTROLLERS
svg.desc: A management computer holds the repository with AaronLocker and AccessChk, builds the AppLocker baseline on a reference domain controller over WinRM, and publishes an Audit GPO and an Enforce GPO that are both linked to the Domain Controllers OU with exactly one link enabled. The domain controllers apply the active GPO and the Application Identity service enforces the rules for code started in a user's context, while SYSTEM, elevated administrators and services are not restricted. The lower panel shows the methodology from Audit to Enforce and the DISA STIG outcome for WN25-00-000080 / V-277992.
svg.text: WINDOWS SERVER 2025 CORE · AARONLOCKER BASELINE · AUDIT + ENFORCE GPOs · ONE ENABLED LINK · NO INTERNET NEEDED
VERIFIED IN THE LAB · SERVER CORE 2025 DC · ENFORCE
the management computer builds and deploys · Group Policy carries the rules · the DCs enforce
